status: frozen before evaluation in this script
scope: Exploratory adaptation of six available criteria from the user-provided nine-item screenshot. Not full BindCraft validation. No trained parameters.

criteria.label: Complex pLDDT
criteria.source_note: Whole-complex ESMFold2-Fast mean /100, following screenshot wording. Source-code binder-mean alternative is reported separately; neither is AF2.

criteria.label: Global ipTM
criteria.source_note: Original ESMFold2-Fast global ipTM; unchanged after Rosetta.

criteria.label: Normalized interchain PAE
criteria.source_note: Arithmetic mean over both full interchain blocks, divided by31; equivalent to mean PAE<10.85Å. Not ipSAE.

criteria.label: Interface shape complementarity
criteria.source_note: Saved Rosetta InterfaceAnalyzer value; original or median over relaxed seeds101/102/103.

criteria.label: Interface hydrogen bonds
criteria.source_note: Saved Rosetta InterfaceAnalyzer count; original or independent median over relaxed seeds101/102/103.

criteria.label: Interface Lys / Met limits
criteria.source_note: K<3 AND M<3. Distinct binder residues contacting antigen at≤4Å; heavy atoms only in both states. Median K and M counts over relaxed seeds independently.

missing_criteria.label: Buried unsatisfied hydrogen bonds <4
missing_criteria.reason: Source-defined buried unsatisfied polar-atom measurement is not available/qualified for this cohort; no zero imputation.

missing_criteria.label: Binder surface hydrophobicity <35%
missing_criteria.reason: Source-defined surface-residue calculation is missing; sequence hydrophobicity is not substituted.

missing_criteria.label: Bound-versus-free binder RMSD <3.5Å
missing_criteria.reason: Independent free-binder predictions are unavailable; extracting the bound chain is not a free prediction.

rule: Predicted B iff all six measured criteria pass. Any failed measured criterion predicts NB (screening rejection). Any missing measured criterion without a known failure is indeterminate. The omitted three criteria are outside this explicitly partial classifier, not assumed passed.
full_nine_rule: Unavailable; no full-nine predicted B/NB performance is claimed. ESMFold2-Fast confidence also differs from source AF2.
operators: Strict screenshot > and <; do not round input values before thresholding. Separate K and M caps, not K+M.
structure_policy: Keep original and relaxed arms separate. Independent descriptor medians across seeds101/102/103 follow the existing evaluator; these can combine descriptors from different replicates.
confidence_policy: Original ESMFold2-Fast pLDDT, ipTM, PAE unchanged in both coordinate arms. No AF2 equivalence claimed.
plddt_scope: Whole-complex mean is the screenshot-literal primary; binder-only mean is a labeled source-implementation sensitivity, not a test-selected replacement.
contact_scope: Heavy-atom 4Å inclusive contacts in both coordinate states. Excluding H/D prevents added relaxed hydrogens changing the atom inventory.
scoring_scope: Uses existing REF2015 InterfaceAnalyzer settings, pack_input=false, pack_separated=false. This differs from BindCraft preparation/scoring and model ensembles; not an exact source-workflow replication.
evaluation: Exact existing saved test IDs and family assignments. No train or validation data used to fit or tune filters. Fixed predictions do not change with the source training antigen.
metrics: Confusion counts, recall, precision, specificity, balanced accuracy, F1, MCC and coverage. AUROC/AP/probability metrics N/A for this fixed operating-point classifier; binary decisions are not calibrated probabilities.
label_definition: Binder and weak binder = B; explicit nonbinder = NB; failed expression and missing experimental measurements stay excluded per original cohort.
